manual.title: Manual setup
manual.description: Connection details for the speaker (SSC protocol, port 45).

data.name: Name (e.g. "KH 120 II Left")
data.interface: Network interface (select from list, or type a custom value if not shown — only needed for link-local addresses)

scan.title: Discovered speakers
scan.description: Select a discovered device, or search again.

reconfigure.title: Change connection details
reconfigure.description: New connection details for {device}. The name, entities and history are kept.

data.interface: Network interface (select from list, or type a custom value if not shown — only needed for link-local addresses)

unsupported.title: Device of another manufacturer
unsupported.description: This device reports itself as "{product}" by "{vendor}" and is not a Neumann speaker. It speaks SSC, so the integration can control it, but anything model-specific (subwoofer entities, EQ layout, factory reset) is a guess and may not match. Submit to add it anyway.

scan_confirm.title: Name the speaker
scan_confirm.description: Device: {device}. Pre-filled if this device had a name before.

zeroconf_confirm.title: Speaker found on the network
zeroconf_confirm.description: Device: {device}. Pre-filled if this device had a name before.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the speaker. Check IP address and interface.
error.timeout: Timeout - no response received from the speaker.
error.interface_required_for_link_local: A fe80:: address requires the network interface to be set.
error.invalid_ipv6: Not a valid IPv6 address. Neumann KH speakers only support IPv6 (e.g. fe80::...), not IPv4.
error.no_devices_found: No SSC speakers found on the network. Submit again to retry, or go back and choose manual setup.
error.discovery_expired: The device list has expired, please search again.
error.name_required: Please enter a name for the device.
error.scan_failed: The network scan failed unexpectedly. Try again, or use manual setup.

abort.wrong_device: A different speaker answered at that address (serial number does not match). Nothing was changed.
abort.no_serial: The device announced itself without a serial number and cannot be identified.
abort.no_ipv6: The device announced no IPv6 address. Neumann KH speakers only support IPv6.
abort.cannot_connect: The discovered device did not respond to SSC requests.
abort.discovery_expired: The discovery result has expired, please search again.
abort.unknown: Unexpected error - the setup was cancelled.

change_rejected.message: The speaker rejected this change (possibly not supported by this model/firmware): {error}

selection_rejected.message: The speaker rejected this selection (possibly not supported by this model/firmware): {error}

factory_reset_rejected.message: The speaker rejected the factory reset: {error}

eq_reset_rejected.message: The speaker rejected the EQ reset: {error}

name_rejected.message: The speaker rejected the new name: {error}

restore_no_backup.message: No backup stored for this speaker yet. Press 'Create backup' first.

restore_model_mismatch.message: This backup is from a {backup}, but the device is a {device}. Nothing was written.

restore_serial_mismatch.message: The stored backup belongs to a different speaker. Nothing was written.

restore_interrupted.message: The connection dropped after {written} values had already been written; the speaker is only partly restored. Press again once it is reachable. ({error})

backup_empty.message: The speaker answered none of the queries, so there is nothing to back up. The previous backup was kept.

restore_nothing_to_write.message: The stored backup holds no value this speaker can be restored from. Create a new backup first.

discovery_empty.message: The speaker answered none of the queries, so there is nothing to record. The previous discovery was kept.

backup_timed_out.message: The speaker did not answer all queries within {seconds} seconds. Nothing was saved - the previous backup was kept.

discovery_timed_out.message: The speaker did not answer all queries within {seconds} seconds. Nothing was recorded - the previous discovery was kept.

restore_timed_out.message: The restore was stopped after {seconds} seconds; {written} values had been written by then. The speaker is only partly restored. Pressing again starts over from the first value - it does not resume where it stopped.

device_action_in_progress.message: Another action is still running on this speaker (backup, discovery, restore or factory reset). Wait for it to finish, then press again.

restore_nothing_written.message: The speaker accepted none of the values in the backup ({skipped} skipped), so nothing was changed. Check that the backup belongs to this model and firmware.
